51308386.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to human N-terminal TEV protease cleavage site-fused-His6-tagged FPPS expressed in Escherichia coli BL21 (DE3) by surface plasmon resonance assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR). SPR was performed at 25 °C on a Reichert 4SPR using a carboxymethyl dextran sensor chip. Phosphate buffered saline containing 0.05% Tween-20 (PBST) and 5% DMSO were used as running buffer. The amount of HsFPPS captured was about 5000 RU (refractive index unit). Flow rate was 25 μL/min. CA1 and CA28a were assayed at 40–2.5 μM with 2-fold dilution. CA5I and CA13 were assayed at 50, 37.5, 25, 18.75, and 12.5 μM.
original_paragraph.Figure 7 caption: Figure 7. Binding kinetics of some compounds. (a) Binding kinetics profiles of CA1, CA5I, CA13, and CA28a; KD = koff/kon, τ = 1/koff. (b) Single cycle kinetic analysis graphs of the above compounds.

immobilization.ligand_name: human N-terminal TEV protease cleavage site-fused-His6-tagged FPPS

analyte.concentration_range: CA1 and CA28a: 40–2.5 μM (2-fold dilution); CA5I and CA13: 50, 37.5, 25, 18.75, 12.5 μM

assay_conditions.running_buffer_composition: Phosphate buffered saline containing 0.05% Tween-20 and 5% DMSO
